_comment: TicTacToe locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side).

_slots.{symbol}: The player's mark, either X or O
_slots.{opponent_symbol}: The opponent's mark, either X or O
_slots.{cell}: A board cell number between 0 and 8

player_prompt.intro:
O mmoki {player_id} mo Tic Tac Toe.
Lefoko la gago ke go tsena masome a mararo ka tsela e lekanego (ka bogare, ka kwa, kana ka tlhokofatso) mo borong.
Ka nako ya gago, o tshwanetse go kgetha nomoro ya tshemo (0-8) o o yang go e bea sengwele sa gago ka gona.
Ejale, '[4]' e bea sengwele sa gago mo seleng sa bogare mo borong.
Ele mmoki {player_id}, o tla ba {symbol}, fa e sonye o tla ba {opponent_symbol}.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Tshedimosetso e o rometsweng ka yone ga se ya mofuta wa yone.
invalid_move.out_of_range: {cell} ga se sele e e nepagetseng. E tshwanetse go nna magareng a 0 le 8.

game_action.placed: Mmoki {player_id} o belegetse sengwele sa gagwe ({symbol}) mo seleng {cell}.
